mapper.sql: WITH production_reserved AS ( SELECT d.live_stock_id, SUM(GREATEST(COALESCE(d.reserved_num, 0) - COALESCE(d.consumed_num, 0) - COALESCE(d.released_num, 0), 0)) AS reserved_num FROM "mom_wms".wms_material_reservation_detail d JOIN "mom_wms".wms_material_reservation r ON r.id = d.reservation_id AND r.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND r.factory_code = d.factory_code AND r.del_flag = '0' AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND d.factory_code = #{factoryCode} AND d.del_flag = '0' AND d.status = 'ACTIVE' AND d.live_stock_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.live_stock_id ), sales_reserved AS ( SELECT d.live_stock_id, SUM(GREATEST(COALESCE(d.reserved_num, 0) - COALESCE(d.consumed_num, 0) - COALESCE(d.released_num, 0), 0)) AS reserved_num FROM "mom_wms".wms_sales_stock_reservation_detail d JOIN "mom_wms".wms_sales_stock_reservation r ON r.id = d.reservation_id AND r.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND r.factory_code = d.factory_code AND r.del_flag = '0' AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND d.factory_code = #{factoryCode} AND d.del_flag = '0' AND d.status = 'ACTIVE' AND d.live_stock_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.live_stock_id ), stock_base AS ( SELECT s.id AS stock_id, s.warehouse_code, s.warehouse_name, s.site_code, s.site_name, s.mat_code, s.mat_name, s.mat_batch, s.mat_unit, s.quality_status, s.quality_result, s.status AS lock_status, s.in_time, s.mat_valid_end_date AS valid_end_date, COALESCE(s.mat_num, 0)::numeric AS physical_num, COALESCE(pr.reserved_num, 0)::numeric AS production_reserved_num, COALESCE(sr.reserved_num, 0)::numeric AS sales_reserved_num, (s.status IS NULL OR s.status <> 0) AS locked, (s.mat_valid_end_date IS NOT NULL AND s.mat_valid_end_date < #{today}) AS expired, (s.mat_valid_end_date IS NOT NULL AND s.mat_valid_end_date >= #{today} AND s.mat_valid_end_date <= #{nearExpiryEnd}) AS near_expiry, (COALESCE(s.slow_material_status, FALSE) OR (s.in_time IS NOT NULL AND s.in_time < #{slowBefore})) AS slow_moving, ( (NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(s.quality_status, '')), '') IS NULL OR BTRIM(s.quality_status) IN ('QUALIFIED', 'CONCESSION', 'RELEASED')) AND ( BTRIM(COALESCE(s.quality_result, '')) IN ('QUALIFIED', 'EXEMPTION', 'RELEASE', 'RECEIVE', 'CONCESSION') OR ((NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(s.is_quality_test, '')), '') IS NULL OR BTRIM(s.is_quality_test) = '0') AND NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(s.quality_result, '')), '') IS NULL) ) ) AS quality_ok FROM "mom_wms".wms_live_stock s LEFT JOIN production_reserved pr ON pr.live_stock_id = s.id LEFT JOIN sales_reserved sr ON sr.live_stock_id = s.id WHERE s.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND s.factory_code = #{factoryCode} AND s.del_flag = '0' AND COALESCE(s.mat_num, 0) <> 0 ), stock_health AS ( SELECT b.*, (NOT b.locked AND NOT b.expired AND b.quality_ok) AS usable, CASE WHEN NOT b.locked AND NOT b.expired AND b.quality_ok THEN b.physical_num ELSE 0 END AS usable_physical_num, GREATEST(CASE WHEN NOT b.locked AND NOT b.expired AND b.quality_ok THEN b.physical_num ELSE 0 END - b.production_reserved_num - b.sales_reserved_num, 0) AS available_num FROM stock_base b )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS stock_row_count, COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(BTRIM(mat_code), '')) AS material_count, COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(BTRIM(warehouse_code), '')) AS warehouse_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE locked) AS locked_row_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT quality_ok) AS quality_restricted_row_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE expired) AS expired_row_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE near_expiry) AS near_expiry_row_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE slow_moving) AS slow_moving_row_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE physical_num < 0) AS negative_row_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE production_reserved_num + sales_reserved_num > usable_physical_num) AS over_reserved_row_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(mat_unit, '')), '') IS NULL) AS missing_unit_row_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(site_code, '')), '') IS NULL) AS missing_location_row_count FROM stock_health

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(mat_unit), ''), 'MISSING_UNIT') AS unit_code, COUNT(*) AS stock_row_count, SUM(physical_num) AS physical_num, SUM(usable_physical_num) AS usable_physical_num, SUM(production_reserved_num) AS production_reserved_num, SUM(sales_reserved_num) AS sales_reserved_num, SUM(available_num) AS available_num, SUM(CASE WHEN locked THEN physical_num ELSE 0 END) AS locked_num, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT quality_ok THEN physical_num ELSE 0 END) AS quality_restricted_num, SUM(CASE WHEN expired THEN physical_num ELSE 0 END) AS expired_num, SUM(CASE WHEN near_expiry THEN physical_num ELSE 0 END) AS near_expiry_num, SUM(CASE WHEN slow_moving THEN physical_num ELSE 0 END) AS slow_moving_num FROM stock_health GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(mat_unit), ''), 'MISSING_UNIT') ORDER BY unit_code

SELECT stock_id, warehouse_code, warehouse_name, site_code, site_name, mat_code, mat_name, mat_batch, mat_unit, physical_num, production_reserved_num, sales_reserved_num, available_num, quality_status, quality_result, lock_status, in_time, valid_end_date, CONCAT_WS(',', CASE WHEN physical_num < 0 THEN 'NEGATIVE_STOCK' END, CASE WHEN production_reserved_num + sales_reserved_num > usable_physical_num THEN 'OVER_RESERVED' END, CASE WHEN locked THEN 'LOCKED' END, CASE WHEN NOT quality_ok THEN 'QUALITY_RESTRICTED' END, CASE WHEN expired THEN 'EXPIRED' END, CASE WHEN near_expiry THEN 'NEAR_EXPIRY' END, CASE WHEN slow_moving THEN 'SLOW_MOVING' END, CASE WHEN NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(mat_unit, '')), '') IS NULL THEN 'MISSING_UNIT' END, CASE WHEN NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(site_code, '')), '') IS NULL THEN 'MISSING_LOCATION' END ) AS exception_codes FROM stock_health WHERE physical_num < 0 OR production_reserved_num + sales_reserved_num > usable_physical_num OR locked OR NOT quality_ok OR expired OR near_expiry OR slow_moving OR NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(mat_unit, '')), '') IS NULL OR NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(site_code, '')), '') IS NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN physical_num < 0 THEN 1 WHEN production_reserved_num + sales_reserved_num > usable_physical_num THEN 2 WHEN expired THEN 3 WHEN NOT quality_ok THEN 4 WHEN locked THEN 5 WHEN near_expiry THEN 6 WHEN slow_moving THEN 7 ELSE 8 END, valid_end_date NULLS LAST, in_time, stock_id LIMIT #{limit}
